description: Act on sims in your lease: `screenshot` (returns file paths), `open-url` (deep link, pass `url`), `launch` the app, `reset` (restore seeded app data), or `rebuild` (fresh clone; the UDID changes, the result maps old to new).

epoch.description: The epoch from sim_farm_acquire. A stale epoch is refused.

requestId.description: Any unique string for this call. Repeating the same call with the same requestId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: sim_farm_action
